title: What Constitutional Capitalism Changed Its Mind About
intro: Stage 4 killed and redesigned ideas that did not survive hostile attack. History is preserved—dead propositions are not rewritten as if they always failed.

entries.reason: Replacement capacity and COUNTABLE waterfall refuse fake cash; shocks expose procyclical collapse risk.
entries.final: FAILED — transition only when replacement clears waterfall and shock tests.

entries.original: Public ownership as default prosperity engine
entries.reason: Default ownership invites soft budgets, capture, and role conflict.

entries.original: Productive retention / buy-local as always good
entries.reason: Local can raise costs, block competition, and harm households.
entries.final: FAILED as always-good — replaced by net-capability retention principle.

entries.original: Demand-side housing relief without supply response
entries.reason: Capitalization / scarcity absorb benefits into prices.
entries.final: FAILED BEHAVIORALLY — supply + Growth Absorption required.
